mobbin:278b5778-83b4-4ad3-a5ea-296d26fa2.summary: From empty week calendar, open New event sidebar, fill title/date/time (30-min default, live grid preview), adjust duration, and keep Save available beside optional participants/location/Repeats.
steal: Steps 1–2: Save stays disabled until a title exists; default slot is 30 minutes with live untitled/titled block on the week grid.
Steps 2–7: Sidebar create keeps the week grid visible — draft block updates as date/time change (manual conflict scan).
Steps 1 & 5–6: Core fields (title, date, start→end) first; All day / Repeats / participants / location / description / color stay optional on the same panel.
avoid: No automated conflict or availability check while adding participants — only visual overlap on an empty grid.
mobbin:278b5778-83b4-4ad3-a5ea-296d26fa2.fit: Good cheap full-form-beside-calendar for simple sessions (scenario title, room as location, faculty/learners as participants); Repeats toggle is the series entry, not flexi rostering.

refero:1928.summary: Open a recurring Marketing All-Hands, choose Yes/No/Maybe, confirm scope Only this event vs All events, and see Maybe highlighted with a striped event block.
steps: RSVP modal · this vs all events
steal: Step 1: Inline Yes / No / Maybe on the event sidebar for the invitee (organizer labeled).
Step 3: After RSVP, striped fill on the selected occurrence distinguishes response state on the grid.
avoid: Step 2 'Only this event' / 'All events' scope dialog duplicates Amie/Motion series-scope already covered elsewhere — don’t treat as a new pattern.
refero:1928.fit: Learner/faculty invitee RSVP for session series; reuse Yes/No/Maybe + visual response state, borrow series-scope from prior course research not this capture.
